IT-4301                                                                                                                about:srcdoc  
  
  
  Exam Date & Time: 16-Jan-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  FIFTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - JANUARY-2024  
  Computer Graphics and Animations [IT-4301]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Construct the line from (-1,1) to (5,-8) using Bresenhams line drawing Algorithm.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Identify the significance of OpenGL library functions.                                    (3)  
  C)      Identify the matrix representation for scaling, translation, and rotation                 (2)  
  2)           Let ABCD be the regular window with A(20, 20), B(90, 20), C(90, 70),and D(20, 70).  
  Examine the region codes for endpoints and use the Cohen-Sutherland algorithm to clip  
  (5)  
  the lines P(10, 30) and Q(80, 90).  
  A)  
  B)      Identify the possible four cases in Sutherland-Hodgman Polygon Clipping.                  (5)  
  3)           Inference the transformation matrix for 3D scaling followed by rotation about a fixed  
  point  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Identify the procedure to transform the scene from the world coordinate system to the  
  viewing coordinate system in 3D viewing.                                                  (5)  
  
  4)           Develop a raster transformation for 2D objects using OpenGL.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Analyze the matrix for the rotation of an object about an arbitrary axis.                 (5)  
  5)           Utilize the Scan-Line Polygon Fill Algorithm for a 2D object.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Identify the tricks used in computer graphics animation                                   (3)  
  C)      Develop a code to draw a line in OpenGL.                                                  (2)
